command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== the staged bytes must be the pinned bytes before anything is derived from them =="
printf '%s  truth.fa\n%s  reads.fastq\n' \
  84b52268ce9b404f699159ba5de2a02ddb94f9854d6ab0bf3969afea353ef607 8eeaa55ec09e952fd1497158784f31a37bf150faee554e86164f1a58ee5a4db8 > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "staged inputs do not match their pins"; exit 1; }

TL=$(awk '!/^>/{n+=length($0)} END{print n}' truth.fa)
NRD=$(awk 'END{print NR/4}' reads.fastq)
BASES=$(awk 'NR%4==2{n+=length($0)} END{print n}' reads.fastq)
echo "truth_bp\t$TL"
echo "reads\t$NRD"
printf 'depth\t%.0fx\n' "$(awk -v b=$BASES -v t=$TL 'BEGIN{print b/t}')"
test "$TL" = "6361" || { echo "truth is $TL bp, expected the depositors 6361"; exit 1; }

echo "== a draft with a KNOWN number of planted errors, cut into the REAL reference =="
# Errors are planted at fixed positions with a fixed seed, so the draft is byte-reproducible
# and the error count is exact rather than estimated. This is the only synthetic part of the
# fixture now: the sequence, the reads and the truth are all the depositors'.
awk 'function other(c,  m){ m="ACGT"; return substr(m, (index(m,c) % 4) + 1, 1) }
BEGIN{
  while ((getline l < "truth.fa") > 0) if (l !~ /^>/) T = T l
  D = T; nsub=0
  for (p=150; p<=5400; p+=300) { D = substr(D,1,p-1) other(substr(D,p,1)) substr(D,p+1); nsub++ }
  ndel=0; split("5700 5900 6100", dl, " ")
  for (i=3; i>=1; i--) { p=dl[i]+0; D = substr(D,1,p-1) substr(D,p+1); ndel++ }
  printf ">draft\n%s\n", D > "draft.fa"
  printf "planted_substitutions\t%d\nplanted_deletions\t%d\ndraft_bp\t%d\n", nsub, ndel, length(D) > "fixture.tsv"
}'
cat fixture.tsv
DL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="draft_bp"{print $2}' fixture.tsv)
test $(( TL - DL )) = 3 || { echo "draft/truth length gap is not the 3 planted deletions"; exit 1; }

echo "== the draft must actually differ from the truth =="
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' truth.fa > t.seq
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' draft.fa > d.seq
cmp -s t.seq d.seq && { echo "draft identical to truth -- nothing to polish"; exit 1; }
echo "draft != truth, as planted"

echo "== align the REAL reads to the draft =="
minimap2 --version
minimap2 -x map-ont -t 2 draft.fa reads.fastq > ov.paf 2> mm.log
NPAF=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' ov.paf)
echo "paf_alignments\t$NPAF for $NRD reads"
# Real reads do not all align, and some align more than once -- a circular plasmid read past
# its origin produces supplementary alignments. So this is a floor, not an equality.
test "$NPAF" -ge 100 || { echo "only $NPAF alignments -- the fixture is not aligning"; exit 1; }
cp fixture.tsv align-diag.txt
{ printf 'minimap2_version\t%s\n' "$(minimap2 --version)"
  printf 'truth_bp\t%s\nreads\t%s\npaf_alignments\t%s\n' "$TL" "$NRD" "$NPAF"; } >> align-diag.txt
echo "ALIGN OK"
